name: Eucalyptol+ Menthol + Thymol
indication_description: Eucalypytol, Menthol & Thymol mouthwash is indicated for Gingivitis, Oral hygiene, Cavities, Bad breath, Plaque, Gum disease, Teeth cleaner & brighter.
dosage_description: Rinse with 20 ml Antiseptic Mouthwash for 30 seconds, twice daily (morning and evening). Then rinse with water. Do not swallow. Not indicated below 12 years of age.
side_effects_description: Do not rinse, eat, or smoke for thirty minutes after using a mouthwash. Doing so will diminish the effects of the mouthwash.
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: FDA has not yet classified the drug into a specified pregnancy category.
precautions_description: Do not swallow. It is not indicated below 12 years of age. Keep out of the reach of children. Keep in a cool and dry palace. Do not use if cap seal is broken.
storage_conditions_description: Keep below 30°C temperature, away from light & moisture. Keep out of the reach of children.
